view_issues: Summary says incidence 'significantly increased' in 2022, but the article reports no tests, p-values or CIs; read as colloquial, not a test. Abstract gives 2013–2021 rubella decline to 1.0 per million while Table gives 0.98 for 2021 and text cites a 2020 low of 0.6.
